title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：package　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 package 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the postman ① sent the package that no sender in the office would have counted, and he said the sending was the whole of the week. The ② package, meaning the box itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a package, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ package in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ package at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A package, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the postman said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the package was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the box. The ⑥ package, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; package, he said, is either something you send or the only word that means both a box and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ package had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ package of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of counting; package, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ package I remember is the box counted in the list, which closed in 1981 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ package, my mother said in 1983, is the only box that improves by being counted; every package, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a box. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 包裹；包装（指邮局里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 包裹；包装（指那个包裹本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：send the package 寄这一个包裹
D. n. 包裹；包装（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 包裹之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的包裹之事）
F. n. 包裹；包装（指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 包裹、心意（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心意（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sent the package that no sender in the office would have counted
The package, meaning the box itself and not the envelope
the package at the far box
the package was the whole of the matter
the package had become a line in a list
The package of the whole thing
A package, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: send the package 意为“寄这一个包裹”，1974 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯清点的一个包裹做了一遍。
package 意为“包裹；包装”，指那个包裹本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
package 意为“包裹；包装”，指邮局里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
package 意为“包裹；包装”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
package 意为“包裹、心意”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个心意就是那件事的全部。
package 意为“心意”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个包裹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
package 意为“包裹；包装”，指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1979 年这一个成了收发清单里的一行。
package 意为“包裹之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的包裹之事是一处邮局和三个星期的清点。
package 意为“包裹；包装”，我记得的是收发清单里清点过的那一个，1981 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一个。
package 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，包裹是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的包裹。
